verdict.rationale: Termius docs claim device-bound keys with biometric protection (Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, Android biometrics) and FIDO2/MFA support, which aligns closely with the hardware-enclave+biometrics story. However, other docs stress cloud-synced, passphrase-encrypted keys, and community feedback expresses distrust over key storage on Termius' servers and lack of transparency about crypto implementation, undercutting confidence in a true hardware-enclave guarantee.
